items.title: Epic: user accounts + multi-tenancy — Auth0 login, tenancy join table, BFF
items.summary:
## Goal

User accounts and multi-tenancy: login via a hosted IdP, per-user tracked-item state on a join table, and a BFF so the browser never holds tokens. Unblocks email notifications (Phase 3) and per-user hidden items.

## Settled decisions (2026-08-30, after consulting Gemini + Codex + an external tie-break)

- **IdP: hosted Auth0** (dev + prod tenants), social login (Google/GitHub) + optional email/password. Not Keycloak (production ops burden for a solo dev), not Spring Authorization Serve
